response.overview: Truth is a matter of perspective—much like a cylinder that appears as a circle from one side and a rectangle from the other. The world around us offers countless possibilities simultaneously; how we experience a given moment—whether for better or worse—depends on our state of mind. The connections between the universe and our own micro-world reveal themselves in tiny details: walking the dog, butterflies, birds, a ladybug, drifting clouds, fish, a paper boat sailing along, a falling leaf, a shy date, the cooing of a dove, piano music.
response.title: The Language of Flowers
